setup.title: Setup Checklist
setup.complete: Setup complete! You're ready to play.
setup.empty: No setup checklist available for this game.

catan.0: Arrange hex tiles in the frame (use beginner layout)
catan.1: Place number tokens on hexes (follow letter order)
catan.2: Place the Robber on the desert hex
catan.3: Each player takes 5 settlements, 4 cities, 15 roads
catan.4: Shuffle and place resource card stacks
catan.6: Place Longest Road and Largest Army cards nearby
catan.7: Each player places 1st settlement + road (youngest first)
catan.8: Each player places 2nd settlement + road (reverse order)

ticket_to_ride.0: Unfold the board in the center of the table
ticket_to_ride.1: Each player takes 45 train cars and a scoring marker
ticket_to_ride.3: Shuffle Train Card deck, deal 4 to each player
ticket_to_ride.5: Shuffle Destination Tickets, deal 3 to each player
ticket_to_ride.6: Each player keeps at least 2 destination tickets

wingspan.0: Each player takes a player mat and 8 action cubes
wingspan.1: Shuffle bird deck, deal 5 birds to each player
wingspan.2: Place 3 bird cards face-up in the tray
wingspan.3: Deal 2 bonus cards to each player (keep 1)
wingspan.4: Give each player 5 food tokens (1 of each type)
wingspan.5: Players choose birds/food to keep (discard 1 food per bird kept)
wingspan.6: Place round-end goal tiles for all 4 rounds
wingspan.7: Roll all 5 food dice into the birdfeeder
